metadata.description: Home marketplace for goalify — the Claude Code skill that writes a brief for the fresh session to work from and derives the /goal condition it has to prove, so an unattended run ends with evidence you can check.

plugins.name: goalify
plugins.description: goalify preps a big coding task while Claude still has your context: it locks the real decisions, writes a self-contained brief (a file the fresh session works from) and derives the /goal condition (a string — /goal never takes a file path), so an unattended run finishes the job and shows evidence you can check.
